opening.argument: Several risk signals appear together: a free investment-related benefit, external redirection, cryptocurrency services, a hardware-wallet discount, and account-opening prompts. The description does not merely mention crypto; it repeatedly encourages viewers to take action through linked destinations, including a free strategy and wallet-related offers. Against that backdrop, the unusually easy promise of a free long-term investment strategy deserves heightened scrutiny. Nothing supplied identifies the provider, explains eligibility, or states what the viewer receives without proceeding through the external link, so the combination reasonably presents as a deceptive acquisition funnel rather than neutral commentary.

The links give the promotional framing a concrete participation pathway.
